title: Uniform doubling on compact homogeneous spaces with cyclic Lie brackets
summary: We establish the uniform doubling property for $G$-invariant metrics on a wide class of compact Riemannian homogeneous spaces $(G/K,g)$, describing explicitly the volume growth of the metric balls $B_g(p,r)$. This property was previously known only for specific cases, including abelian Lie groups, the Lie group $SU(2)$ and quotients of $SU(2)\times \mathbb R^n$.
